### Observed differences

- In the later window, A01 appears for the first time: earlier it never occurs, later it is present in about 56 in 100 traces and averages about 2.4 occurrences per trace overall (roughly 4 per trace that contains it, so it usually repeats), sits around the middle of the trace (mean relative position about 0.49), and its outgoing transitions split almost evenly over A11, A09, A05 and A02 (about a quarter each). [OCC001, POS001, DIR001]
- In the later window, A14 is no longer observed at all: earlier it ran exactly once in every trace near the end (mean relative position about 0.95) and always led to A03. [OCC003, POS006, DIR010]
- The ending changed: earlier A03 and A14 always occurred together and alternated — A03 led only to A14 and A14 only to A03, with the trace ending on A14 in about half of the cases and on A03 in the other half; in the later window A03 is the final event of every trace (relative position 1.0 throughout) and shows no outgoing transitions. [DIR002, DIR010, REL017, POS002]
- In the later window several activities route into A01: A09 and A13, which earlier split their outgoing transitions between A02 and A11, now lead exclusively to A01; A08, A10 and A17 send about half of their transitions to A01 (about 53%, 53% and 58%); A06, earlier split between A03 (52%) and A14 (48%), now always leads to A03, and always immediately (distance 1 in all observed pairs, where earlier about half were at distance 2). [DIR006, DIR009, DIR005, DIR007, DIR011, DIR004, LAG015]
- A01's relations with the rest flipped: earlier, traces containing A03, A06 or A14 never contained A01; in the later window A01 co-occurs with A03 and with A06 in about 56 in 100 traces, mostly interleaved or repeated, while A14 now appears only without A01. [REL002, REL004, REL011]
- A05 receded: earlier present in about 62 in 100 traces with about 2.0 occurrences per trace; later in about 29 in 100 with about 1.2. [OCC002]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis of a structural change in which A14 is no longer executed and A01 is now executed, usually repeatedly, in about half of the cases: earlier every trace passed once through A14 near the end as part of an alternating A03–A14 pair, whereas in the later window A14 is unobserved, A03 terminates every trace, and A01 appears mid-trace, receiving transitions from A09 and A13 (now exclusively) and from A08, A10 and A17 (about half of their transitions), and leading on to A11, A09, A05 and A02 in roughly equal shares. The signs are direct and consistent: participation flips that sampling cannot produce (A01 in 0 of 200 vs 112 of 200 traces; A14 in 200 of 200 vs 0 of 200), successor changes in the directional profiles, and co-occurrence flips in the relational items; the screening also flagged 129 control-flow items where roughly 1 would qualify by chance without a change, so the ensemble as a whole is not explainable by sampling. Limitations: the agreeing indicators largely describe the same traces rather than independent confirmations, and the evidence cannot show whether A01 is a genuinely new step or a relabelled one, nor whether A14's disappearance and A01's appearance are a single substitution or two independent changes. [OCC001, OCC003, POS001, POS002, POS006, DIR001, DIR002, DIR006, DIR009, REL011, REL017]

Other differences: A05 was also rewired, not only reduced — A11 now leads to A15 or A16 (about half each) instead of to A05, and A05 leads to A13 instead of A16; A06 and A11 now occur later in traces than before (mean relative position up by about 0.09 and 0.10); and many activity-pair distances shifted, although several of those items rest on fewer than about 20 observations. [OCC002, DIR003, DIR008, POS003, POS005, LAG014]
